name: Holiday Sweet Cornbread Soufflé vs. Whole-Kernel Corn Casserole
whyItWorks: Fine-ground cornbread baked with eggs is soft, but traditional Jiffy corn pudding folds in whole corn kernels and creamed corn whose indigestible cellulose hulls act like sandpaper on inflamed intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If making at home, bake plain smooth Jiffy Cornbread Muffins (no whole corn kernels added) with honey butter; at a potluck, skip whole-kernel corn pudding and take mashed potatoes or dinner rolls instead.
watchOuts: Whole corn kernels have tough insoluble cellulose hulls that do not break down in the GI tract
